verdict.rationale: Namecheap is a SaaS registrar and DNS platform, so a built-in scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no such capability. The API, Go SDK, and Terraform provider are developer building blocks, and Dynamic DNS relies on a user-run update client to refresh IPs, so neither is a first-party recurring scheduler. Because these are workarounds or adjacent features, they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
